draft.subject: BiteSpeed — Japan rollout for WhatsApp cart recovery
draft.body:
Hi BiteSpeed team,

We’re A-one Road, a Yokohama company supporting commerce technology firms in Japan. We’re contacting BiteSpeed about WhatsApp cart-recovery conversations for Japanese DTC customer-support teams coordinating assisted purchases.

Japan’s May 2026 labour survey found regular-staff shortages at 34% of surveyed wholesale/retail establishments. For lean support teams, structured recovery conversations can reduce repetitive outreach while keeping product questions and purchase follow-up in one workflow.

We can lead one year of paid Japan market development: identify the entry application, evaluate Japanese buyer requirements, shape local introduction, and develop partner channels. Buyer evidence would guide conversation routing, response ownership, and escalation rules. Can we help plan and execute BiteSpeed’s Japan rollout around this workflow?

https://calendar.app.google/adKEhXC4UWhQXfJp6

Best regards,
Kazuma Tamura
Founder & CEO, A-one Road Co., Ltd. (Yokohama, Japan)
